tag.name: Storefront
tag.description: Public storefront availability and booking holds.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant identifier. Accepts either the canonical tenant UUID or the storefront slug; resolved to the canonical UUID before processing.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `public anonymous`

Anonymous public endpoint backing the storefront booking widget. Creates a pending booking hold for the tenant via the `create_booking_hold` SECURITY DEFINER RPC. No authentication is required; abuse is gated by the RPC's per-IP and per-tenant rate limits. At least one of `customer_id`, `guest_email`, or `guest_phone` must be supplied so the owner has a way to confirm the request.

201.description: Booking hold created. Only the hold id and expiry are returned; no internal scheduling detail is exposed.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant identifier. Accepts either the canonical tenant UUID or the storefront slug; resolved to the canonical UUID before processing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the booking hold for which an alternate slot was suggested.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `public anonymous`

Anonymous, single-use endpoint a customer hits from a tokenized email link to accept an owner-suggested alternate booking slot. The single-use token is supplied via the `token` query parameter (no request body). On success the suggestion token is atomically consumed and the agreed slot details are returned. The hold remains in `pending` status — the owner still confirms it separately. Any failure mode (expired, replayed, wrong token, hold not pending, hold not found) returns `410 Gone` with no distinguishing detail to avoid leaking hold state. When the request `Accept` header includes `text/html`, an HTML confirmation page is returned instead of JSON.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Single-use suggestion token (64-character lowercase hex) from the email link.

200.description: Suggestion accepted. Returns the agreed slot details (JSON when the `Accept` header is not `text/html`).

410.description: The link cannot be used: the token is expired, already consumed, invalid, or the hold is no longer pending / not found. No distinguishing detail is returned.

StorefrontHoldCreate.description: Guest-supplied payload to create a booking hold from the storefront widget. At least one of `customer_id`, `guest_email`, or `guest_phone` must be present.

customer_id.description: Identifier of a returning customer the owner has on file. If omitted, contact details are required.

service_id.description: Optional catalog item / service the customer is requesting.

note.description: Optional free-text note from the guest.

StorefrontHold.description: Result of a successful booking-hold creation. Intentionally minimal — no internal scheduling detail is exposed.

hold_id.description: Identifier of the created booking hold.

expires_at.description: When the hold expires (ISO 8601 date-time). The widget displays a confirmation countdown from this value.

StorefrontHoldSuggestionAccepted.description: Agreed slot details returned after a customer accepts an owner-suggested alternate slot.

error.description: Error token or, for validation failures, a flattened Zod error object.

errorId.description: Correlation identifier present on internal (500) errors only.
